title: Spectral Souping: A Unified Framework for Online Preference Alignment
core_contribution: Universal spectral representation in LLMs enables efficient online preference alignment via offline basis policy training + online logit-mixture souping
key_mechanisms: Universal spectral representation: LLM logits lie in structured latent space defined by MDP spectral features
Two-phase methodology: offline basis policy training + online logit-mixture adaptation
Specialized policies: K basis Q-functions, each aligned to distinct preference dimension
Spectral soup policy: linear combination of basis Q-functions with mixture vector lambda
Explicit souping: logit_pi_soup = (1 - sum(lambda_k)) * logit_ref + sum(lambda_k * logit_theta_k)
Implicit souping: rejection sampling from reference policy with lambda-weighted acceptance
Sub-optimality bounds: formal guarantees for policy merging approach
LoRA on all intermediate layers: automatically discovers spectral representation
